verdict.rationale: Sentry documents first-party SDKs that its team builds and maintains for most popular languages and frameworks. Per-platform docs cover Android, Apple (sentry-cocoa), Elixir, Dart and .NET, with concrete init calls and an SDK API for custom event reporting. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience, and no evidence of an official SDK or client library for Sentry's management web API, as distinct from the instrumentation SDKs.
